name: Red Wings Widget
description: Detroit Red Wings NHL schedule widget + companion app: next-game countdown, last result, and division standings.
changelog: Strictly locked widget to 4x2 cell size with resizing completely disabled (android:resizeMode=none).
Tailored pixel-perfect Concept 2 Frosted Ice mockup duplication for Google Pixel 10 Fold dual screens.

Outer cover display 4x2 (~330x140 dp) features seamless Home Red sweater header with dual racing stripes, circular crest badge, floating crimson @ puck badge, frosted matchup card with Away & Home records, floating Little Caesars Arena venue pill, and Playoff Seeds (with glowing red Detroit pill) + In The Hunt standings.
Inner unfolded display 4x2 (~540x170 dp) scales typography, crests, and seed pill spacing across the expansive inner screen without stretching or distorting.
Dynamic RemoteViews size-mapping on Android 12+ automatically selects the optimal layout when folding and unfolding.
Preserved pure white text and specular borders for WCAG AAA contrast across all screens.
